gaps.sentence: My laptop ___ (service) next week, so back up your files beforehand.
gaps.explanation: 'Next week' takes the future passive: will be + serviced (is being serviced is also a valid arrangement).

gaps.sentence: A new ring road ___ (construct) around the city at present.
gaps.explanation: 'At present' requires present continuous passive: is being + constructed.

gaps.sentence: The message ___ have been misheard by the interpreter.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive = modal + have been + past participle: must have been misheard.

gaps.sentence: The fault ___ by the time the auditor arrived.
gaps.explanation: The fixing preceded the arrival: past perfect passive had been + fixed.

gaps.sentence: The office ___ (repaint) at the moment, so we're working from home.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: am/is/are being + past participle. 'At the moment' signals it.

gaps.sentence: The missing manuscripts ___ (find) — the search is officially over.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: have/has been + past participle. The result matters now.

gaps.sentence: Your name ___ (find) anywhere on the guest list, I'm afraid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of ability/possibility: cannot be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The debt ___ (repay) in full by May, he promised.
gaps.explanation: Reported future passive: would be + past participle after a past reporting verb.
